title: Members send handshakes as SemiPrivateMessage when the room requires it; protocol accepts it
description: When mls_semiprivate_message is in required_wire_formats (§3 L173-179): Member commits and proposals go out as SemiPrivateMessage; mimi-protocol accepts it in UpdateRequest and FanoutMessage (protocol-07 §5.3, §5.5). Needs OpenMLS fork work for the sending side.
